rows.evidence: Only the parsed-body guard at claim-record-codecs.ts:215-216. The only TaskAttempt writer is encodeTaskAttemptSnapshot (claim-service.ts:453; execution-entry-service.ts:924), which JSON.stringify's a TaskAttemptSnapshot, and the validator at :783-786 is this same decoder; so a non-object body comes only from a record no platform writer produced. The deleted before-T test did not write one either: it faked the port, building '{broken:' in .dsh-ref/before/tests/work-graph/R4c-execution-read.test.ts:135-140 and asserting unavailable at :256/:266. rows.proposal_note: Keeping the reject and not restoring a tampering test is right (decision 79-4, AGENTS rule 4). Do not delete the one-line guard: the decoder is the exported, registered validator and its return type is parseObject's null, dereferenced at :217; removing it would trade a total codec for a null dereference on a hand-built record.

rows.evidence: The then-arm at claim-record-codecs.ts:245-248 rejects a bad status/outcome combination. Ended Attempts are written only by endedAttemptRecord (attempt-machine.ts:308-310) and endedFromClaimedRecord (:316-320), both with a typed non-null endOutcome: RunOutcome (contracts/dispatch.ts:110; RUN_OUTCOMES mirrors it at claim-record-codecs.ts:132). newTaskAttemptRecord writes endOutcome:null (:270-273), startedAttemptRecord keeps it (:303-305), and attemptOnResolved (:697-699) is reachable only on an ended Attempt (transitionAttempt :545-551 rejects claimed/started). Runtime outcome strings cannot be arbitrary: terminalOutcomeOf maps only the five terminal event types (run-machine.ts:259-304). So only a hand-edited row or the old ended-without-outcome row reaches it; old data is abandoned (decision 79; TP-059 removed that allowance and the attempt-machine.test.ts:699-700 assertion).
rows.proposal_note: Keep, no tampering test: the check is the codec half of attemptNodeOf's 'ended implies an outcome' assumption (attempt-machine.ts:86) and is reached only by a foreign/corrupt record.

rows.evidence: The right operand of the || at claim-record-codecs.ts:247 is evaluated only when a non-ended Attempt carries a non-null endOutcome. Every non-ended writer leaves it null (attempt-machine.ts:269-273 claimed, :303-305 started), and the only writer of a non-null outcome on an existing Attempt is attemptOnResolved (:697-699), which transitionAttempt allows only for node ended_unknown (:545-551, status 'ended'). So the operand needs a hand-edited claimed/started row with an outcome; no current-format writer produces that shape (TP-059 has the history of the old allowance).
rows.proposal_note: Keep untested. Note the else arm also accepts a hand-edited claimed record with a valid RunOutcome; that is still a foreign shape, so it is not a reason to add a test that hand-edits the store.

rows.evidence: The cond-expr then-arm (claim-record-codecs.ts:248, message 'TaskAttempt ended record requires a RunOutcome') needs status 'ended' with an endOutcome outside RUN_OUTCOMES (including null). Both ended writers pass a non-null typed RunOutcome (attempt-machine.ts:308-310, :316-320) and attemptOnResolved only re-stamps an already-ended record with event.outcome (:697-699); no production path writes ended+null since TP-059/decision 79. Only a hand-edited row or a pre-T old-format row reaches it.
rows.proposal_note: Keep, no tampering test; it is the same guard as B-071 and carries the specific damage reason.

rows.evidence: The cond-expr else-arm (claim-record-codecs.ts:248, message 'TaskAttempt endOutcome is not a RunOutcome or null') needs a non-ended Attempt with a non-null endOutcome that is not a legal RunOutcome. rows.proposal_note: Keep untested together with B-071; no platform writer produces the shape today.

rows.evidence: The only call of the local incomplete helper (execution-history-service.ts:83) is :325, after createRunStateReader({ records }).readExecution(scopeCtx, runRef) with no options (:323). readExecution produces not_ready only when watermarkSatisfied fails (run-state-service.ts:168-173, :456-458, :494-496), and it returns true whenever atLeastSeq is undefined; atLeastSeq is set only from options.atLeastCursor (:425-431), which this call never passes. rows.proposal_note: Safe to delete: the helper is local and used only at :325, and 'incomplete' remains a live CoreError elsewhere (contracts/core/results.ts:24; run-state-service.ts:526 etc.), so no type or exhaustive switch depends on it. Do the narrowing both reviewers mention in the same change (:326 would otherwise read .code on a not_ready union member), and no spec line reserves an atLeastCursor for recordExecutionHistory (slice-3-SPEC.md:299 is the general read rule).
